claim_text: The September 18, 2025 felony information in United States v. Anwar Ahmed Adow, 0:25-cr-00353, alleges that Anwar Ahmed Adow was the owner and principal of Liberty Plus LLC, a Roseville, Minnesota company he registered with the State of Minnesota in or about November 2022.

supporting_passages.quote: The defendant ANWAR AHMED ADOW was the owner and principal of Liberty Plus LLC, a company based out of a business suite in Roseville, Minnesota. ADOW registered Liberty Plus LLC with the State of Minnesota in or about November 2022.

editorial_notes: SOS file 1349782500024 original filing 2022-11-17 is consistent with the information’s “in or about November 2022.” SOS confirms registration; the fraud scheme remains alleged.
